title: Redirection of the UE by the core network

entities.name: Redirection of UE between EPC and 5GCN

entities.description: Network behavior support and preferences for CIoT optimizations.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: NAS state where UE has an established connection with the network.

entities.name: Redirection determination condition
entities.description: Condition where network considers UE capabilities and CIoT network behavior to determine redirection.

entities.name: No ongoing registration or service request procedure
entities.description: Condition where there is no active registration or service request procedure for a UE in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.

relations.description: Redirection procedure is guarded by conditions involving UE capabilities and CIoT network behavior.
Redirection procedure includes sending reject message with cause #31.
Condition of no ongoing procedure establishes the need for UE configuration update procedure.
UE configuration update procedure leads to registration request.
Redirection procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-CONNECTED state for certain scenarios.
Receipt of reject message establishes disabling of N1 mode capability.
